schema.app_description: A high-precision digital stopwatch with millisecond accuracy. Track elapsed time, record laps, and resume whenever you need.
schema.howto_name: How to Use the Online Stopwatch
schema.howto_description: The Online Stopwatch is a free and reliable tool for precision time tracking.
schema.step1_text: Click the Play/Pause icon (▶/⏸) to start or stop the timer.
schema.step2_text: Click the Lap button to record split times and total lap duration.
schema.step3_text: Click the Reset button (↺) to clear the timer and delete all recorded laps.

ui.intro_text: Tap to Tool's Online Stopwatch provides millisecond precision for all your timing needs. Ideal for fitness, education, cooking, and performance testing.

content.usage_title: How to Use the Online Stopwatch
content.usage_instructions: Control the timer using these buttons:
content.control_play: Play/Pause (▶/⏸): Starts and stops the countdown.
content.control_lap: Lap: Records split times and displays them in the list below.
content.control_reset: Reset (↺): Resets the stopwatch to zero and clears your lap history.
content.persistence_note: Your time and laps are automatically saved in your browser, so you can pick up right where you left off even after closing the page.
content.purpose_title: What can you use this stopwatch for?
content.purpose_text: Perfect for tracking running splits, study sessions (like the Pomodoro technique), cooking times, or any activity that requires accurate timing and interval logging.
content.footer_share_text: Take control of your time with the precision Online Stopwatch from Tap to Tool!
